title: CCUS Schedule-Revision Audit: Code and Aggregate Checks
description: Source-available code, a five-record synthetic example, expected outputs and previously public aggregate checks supporting Quantifying 2030 Carbon Capture and Storage Capacity across Database Releases. The one-command wrapper recomputes fixed-2025-capacity horizons and cutoff crossings from an already-admitted 2025–2026 cohort; it does not establish source admission or physical delay. Original IEA workbooks, empirical row-level cohorts, coder originals and restricted machine-learning inputs, predictions and fitted objects are excluded. The existing CC BY 4.0 designation applies to the documentation and derived-data layer as specified in the included rights notice; it is not a new blanket software or third-party licence. No journal acceptance or prospective validation is claimed.
